summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal and returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) using the second item; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests and mypy were not run, per instructions.
